description: Screen both parties of a payment before it is sent: sender and receiver names against global watchlists, their countries' AML risk, and an optional Bank of Mauritius exchange rate for the corridor (set currency_from; currency_to defaults to MUR). Returns PROCEED (risk score below 15), REVIEW (15-39, minor indicators such as partial name matches), FLAG (40-74, enhanced due diligence) or BLOCK (75+, e.g. an exact sanctions match: stop and escalate), with a reason and each party's risk. Use it for fiat or crypto payments where you have names; use screen_wallet for wallet addresses only, and create_travel_rule_packet for a stored, verifiable Travel Rule record. The result states when each list was last updated (lists_as_of). Costs $0.008 USDC per successful call via x402 on Base; unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired result and failed calls are not charged.

currency_from.description: Optional source currency, ISO 4217 (e.g. USD); adds the MUR corridor rate

receiver_country.description: Optional receiver ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. MU

sender_country.description: Optional sender ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. GB

name: screen_cross_border_payment

combined_risk_score.description: Higher of the two parties' 0-100 scores

corridor.description: Exchange-rate data when currency_from was given and rates are available, else null

lists_as_of.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) each screening list was last updated, keyed by list (e.g. us_ofac_sdn, eu_consolidated); check it before relying on a clear result

sender.description: name, country_code, risk {score, classification, factors}, watchlist_hits, watchlist_results, jurisdiction

anyOf.description: Returned with isError=true when payment is needed: sign one of `accepts` with an x402 client and repeat the call with the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

accepts.description: Accepted payment options: scheme 'exact', network 'eip155:8453' (Base), USDC asset, amount in 6-decimal atomic units, payTo address

error.description: Why payment is required, or why the submitted payment was rejected

extensions.description: x402 protocol extensions (e.g. bazaar discovery metadata)

resource.description: The paid resource: url, description, mimeType

anyOf.title: x402 PaymentRequired

title: Pre-Screen a Cross-Border Payment
